item.title: Open PDF Editor 0.8.0
item.description: Recognise text and export. Scanned pages now say so, and Tools › Recognise Text… reads them on this Mac with Apple's text recognition, so their words can be found, selected and copied; it reads pages without text unless you choose others, and works out the language by itself. File › Export… saves the document as a Word document, a web page, plain text, PNG or JPEG pictures of its pages, or one TIFF file, for all pages or some, including changes you haven't saved yet. Word documents and web pages made from recognised scans have the text rather than a picture of it.
